mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) compresses equity discount rates through accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 6.5% and housing starts below 900k signal broad economic weakness that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% AND HOUST < 900 (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized and UNRATE < 5.5%), rising federal funds rates above 2.0% signal monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions with FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0 (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales below 375,000 million signals weak consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 375000 (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 900k and industrial production below 110.0 signal broad economic contraction that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 900 AND INDPRO < 110.0 (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that erode real equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (3-year rolling window analysis).
